claim.value: Each case unresolved at the board deadline should receive a specific next evidence request and a responsible owner.
claim.scope: The proposed follow-up requirement for every unresolved case.

provenance.rationale: P030 explicitly supplies the deadline, unresolved-case scope, evidence request and responsibility assignment.

signal_basis.value: The record inquiry leaves cases unresolved at the board deadline, with remaining uncertainty documented rather than forced into a conclusion.
signal_basis.scope: Unresolved individual cases following the documentary inquiry.

provenance.rationale: These spans describe documented residual uncertainty and unresolved cases reported at the deadline without forced closure.
This bounded procedural recommendation requires no unresolved empirical relation to license it.

rationale: Remaining evidentiary uncertainty licenses specifying what evidence to pursue next and who is responsible. The claim proposes accountable follow-up; it does not assert that further evidence exists or that follow-up will resolve every case.
uncertainty: Whether a future request will succeed remains unknown, but success is outside the claim.
